item.title: Musical Robot: Combining AI Speech and Song to Combat Loneliness
item.description: Researchers find that combining music and empathetic speech makes social robots significantly more effective at bonding with humans and reducing loneliness.

item.title: Dim Lights and Close-Ups May Be the Real Drivers of Myopia
item.description: New research suggests that myopia is caused by low retinal illumination resulting from indoor close-up work and dim lighting.

item.title: DMT Myth? Study Finds No Evidence of “Spirit Molecule” Rat Brains
item.description: "The Spirit Molecule" might be a ghost. A new study finds no evidence that the brain naturally produces or stores DMT, debunking a long-held theory in psychedelic science.

item.title: 40% of Musicians Suffer from Tinnitus and Auditory Distress
item.description: A meta-analysis of 28,000 musicians finds that over 40% suffer from tinnitus, with high rates of hearing loss and hyperacusis across all musical genres.

item.title: Brain’s Body Image Misjudges Robotic Limbs
item.description: Researchers find that people using robotic prosthetics consistently misjudge their own movement, shifting from initial awkwardness to later overconfidence.

item.title: Air Pollution’s Primary Role in Alzheimer’s Risk Identified
item.description: A study of 27 million Americans finds that air pollution directly contributes to Alzheimer’s risk, especially in stroke survivors.

item.title: Brain Swelling Reveals Alzheimer’s Treatment Success
item.description: It’s the side effect every Alzheimer’s patient fears, but it might actually be a sign of success. New research shows brain swelling is tied to better plaque clearance.

item.title: Brain Never Outgrows the Ability to Emotionally Evolve
item.description: Think you're too old to change? Think again. A new study proves that 80-year-olds can improve their emotional stability just as effectively as 20-year-olds.

item.title: Single DMT Dose Provides Lasting Relief from Depression
item.description: A 25-minute "trip" for six months of relief? Researchers have found that the ayahuasca compound DMT provides a rapid, durable shield against depression.

item.title: Brain’s Developmental Switch May Shape Lifelong Obesity Risk
item.description: Is your weight gain pre-programmed? Scientists have discovered a developmental "fate-switch" in the brain that decides if you’ll be driven by hunger or fullness.
